note: Attacker-controlled filter expression string enters the compiler through buf.
The parsed expression is converted into an intermediate control-flow graph rooted at ic.root.
The optimizer is invoked on the attacker-influenced graph, so any optimizer bug is reachable from the input.
On an optimization error, the same opt_state is cleaned up via the longjmp error path.
The normal path also frees the optimizer-owned allocations before returning.

var: opt_state->vnode_base / vmap / edges / space / levels / blocks
code: free((void *)opt_state->vnode_base); free((void *)opt_state->vmap); free((void *)opt_state->edges); free((void *)opt_state->space); free((void *)opt_state->levels); free((void *)opt_state->blocks);
note: The cleanup routine frees all optimizer-owned buffers, but it does not null the pointers afterward.
Because the same opt_state can reach opt_cleanup again after a prior cleanup, this second free hits the same heap chunk a second time, causing the double-free crash.
